name: maxcut_20_3reg
title: MaxCut on a random 3-regular graph with 20 nodes (large: NVIDIA GPU threshold)
description: networkx random_regular_graph(3, 20, seed=7), connected, 30 edges; brute-force max cut 26. 20 qubits is the GPU dispatch threshold on NVIDIA/AMD (16 on Apple).
goal: Show where the GPU pays off.

checks.ideal_ratio_source: 3-regular graphs: p=1 guarantees 0.6924 (Farhi, Goldstone, Gutmann 2014); p=2 guarantees 0.7559 without short cycles (Wurtz & Love, PRA 103, 042612, 2021); deeper plans use the p=2 value (deeper optimal QAOA is never worse)
